PROP-01b-partial3-inv-037.text: Utilization > 100% must be prevented: totalBorrows cannot exceed cash + totalBorrows.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-037.assertion: forall market m: m.totalBorrows <= getCash(m) + m.totalBorrows (tautological; enforce getCash >= 0)

locations.note: Line 197: asserts cash - cash_reserve.ceil() > amount; ensures borrow doesn't exceed available liquidity
Computes utilization as debt / (cash + debt - cash_reserve); could theoretically exceed 1.0 if debt > cash (protocol debt tracking)
